alertsEmitted.summary: PIPA rewritten: 10% turnover fine ceiling, mandatory privacy-policy disclosure of automatic-collection devices (cookies/SDKs), explicit opt-in required when cookie data is combinable with other data to identify individuals. Effective 2026-09-11 (T-91 days).

alertsEmitted.instrument: DPDP Rules 2025 — Phase II Consent Manager provisions effective 2026-11-13
alertsEmitted.summary: India's DPDP Rules create a Consent Manager (CM) registration framework live 2026-11-13. Foreign CMPs cannot self-register; ID-PRIVACY must build CM interoperability API, multilingual banner support, 7-year consent retention for IN locale, and service-conditioning guard.

alertsEmitted.instrument: EU-Brazil Mutual Adequacy Decision — EC Decision & ANPD Resolution No. 32/2026 — effective 2026-01-27
alertsEmitted.summary: Mutual adequacy granted 2026-01-27: EU SCCs no longer required for EU-to-Brazil data transfers (and vice versa). Update adequacy country database in Admin UI, suppress SCC-required warning for Brazil, update TIA templates.

alertsEmitted.instrument: Privacy (Children's Online Privacy) Code 2026 — OAIC Exposure Draft — consultation closed 2026-06-05, final due by 2026-12-10
alertsEmitted.summary: Australia's OAIC released children's privacy code draft (effective by Dec 2026): parental consent required for under-15s, behavioral advertising banned for children without parental consent, age-assurance measures required. Requires AU-children banner flow, age-gate, consent storage extensions, new geo-routing branch.

alertsEmitted.instrument: New Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data held by Private Parties (FLPPDPP) — effective 2025-03-21
alertsEmitted.summary: Mexico's 2010 LFPDPPP fully replaced effective 2025-03-21: tightened consent definition (unambiguous), INAI dissolved (SACG now enforces), criminal penalties introduced, Aviso de Privacidad must disclose tracking technologies. Catch-up alert — gap in MX ruleset and Admin UI labeling identified.

digestItems.instrument: APPI Amendment Bill — Cabinet approved 2026-04-07, Diet pending
digestItems.summary: Japan Cabinet approved APPI bill bringing cookie IDs under new 'contactable personally referable information' restrictions. Not yet enacted. Earliest effective date ~2028. Awareness only.

digestItems.instrument: Privacy and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2024 — 2026 provisions (small business expansion + automated decision-making transparency)
digestItems.summary: Two 2026 effective-date provisions: 100,000 AML-designated small businesses enter Privacy Act scope (2026-07-01); automated decision-making disclosure in privacy policies required (2026-12-10). Minor template updates; no banner changes.
